quotes.text: I'm the king of relatability.
Art gives me the standard to live as a better man, as a better adult, and as an artist.
I want to be a good human being above all else.
I read to remember that I'm not alone.
Life is not about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself.
Maybe I made a mistake yesterday, but yesterday's me is still me. I am who I am today, with all my faults.
I live so I love, I love so I live.
I'm not saying don't look back at the past, but don't be captured by it.
There's so much beauty in the world that we take for granted.
The answer to my existence is within myself.
I want to speak for myself. My name is Kim Namjoon, and I am an artist from South Korea.
I'm still learning. Every day I try to be a better version of myself.
Books are the quietest and most constant of friends.
I believe that there is beauty in everything, even in sadness.
Without pain, there is no growth. Without loss, there is no gain.
I'm not perfect. I make mistakes. But I try my best.
The most important thing is to love yourself.
We have learned to love ourselves, so now I urge you to speak yourself.
No matter who you are, where you're from, your skin colour, your gender identity, just speak yourself.
I collect art because it really gives me the standard to live as a better person.
Music, like literature, lets you live a thousand lives in one.
I want to be remembered as someone who cared. About music, about art, about people.
Every ending is a new beginning. Every goodbye is a new hello.
I think the most courageous thing a person can do is to be exactly who they are.
I'm still figuring out who I am. And I think that's okay.
Art is not something you consume — it's something that consumes you.
The more I read, the more I realise how little I know. And I love that feeling.
Sadness and joy are two sides of the same coin. I try to hold both.
Right Place, Wrong Person — that's how I feel most of the time. And I've made peace with it.
quotes.source: Right Place, Wrong Person Album Interview

quotes.text: I want to connect Oriente and Occidente, past and present, personal and universal.
Every space has a vibe. Sometimes a single artwork can completely change that atmosphere.
I started wanting to be a poet. That naturally evolved into rap. Words have always been my home.
Philip Guston courageously changed his whole world. Because he changed, he could just be himself.
In my thirties, I just want to figure out how to exist as both RM the leader and Namjoon Kim himself.
I want to gather everything into one space. Maybe I'll call it rkive.
